description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans membership table operations using PostgreSQL as the backend database. It defines a test class with multiple test methods for testing various membership table functionalities such as insert, update, read, and cleanup, specifically tailored for PostgreSQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlMembershipTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying PostgreSQL-backed Orleans membership table operations, extending base membership table tests.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logging filters for the tests.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the membership table using PostgreSQL connection options.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a gateway list provider configured for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the invariant name string for PostgreSQL ADO.NET provider.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a test database instance and retrieves the connection string.
